blocks.main: In which book of the Bible do we read about God creating the heavens and the earth in six days?
subs: In which book does Moses receive the Ten Commandments on Mount Sinai?
In which book is the story of Noah building the ark and the great flood recorded?
Exodus
Genesis

blocks.main: In which book does God part the Red Sea so Israel can escape from Egypt?
subs: In which book are the laws of sacrifice, priesthood, and ritual purity laid out in detail?
In which book does Moses deliver his farewell speeches before Israel enters the Promised Land?
Leviticus
Deuteronomy

blocks.main: In which book does Jacob wrestle with a man at night and receive the name Israel?
subs: In which book do the Israelites wander in the wilderness for forty years after leaving Egypt?
In which book does Joseph interpret Pharaoh's dreams of seven fat cows and seven lean cows?
Numbers
Genesis

blocks.main: In which book is David anointed king and later defeats the giant Goliath?
subs: In which book does Solomon build the Temple in Jerusalem?
In which book does Queen Esther save the Jewish people from Haman's plot?
1 Kings
Esther

blocks.main: In which book does the prophet Elijah challenge the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel?
subs: In which book does Elisha receive a double portion of Elijah's spirit?
In which book does Isaiah prophesy that a virgin will conceive and bear a son called Immanuel?
2 Kings
Isaiah

blocks.main: In which book is Daniel thrown into the lions' den but comes out unharmed?
subs: In which book does Jonah spend three days in the belly of a great fish?
In which book does the prophet Micah foretell that Bethlehem will produce a ruler over Israel?
Jonah
Micah

blocks.main: In which Gospel do we read the detailed account of Jesus' birth, including the visit of the Magi?
subs: In which Gospel is Jesus described as the Word who became flesh and dwelt among us?
In which Gospel — the shortest of the four — does Jesus calm a storm on the Sea of Galilee?
John
Mark

blocks.main: In which Gospel does Jesus tell the parable of the Good Samaritan?
subs: In which Gospel alone do we find the parable of the Prodigal Son?
In which Gospel does Jesus raise Lazarus from the dead after he had been in the tomb four days?
Luke
John

blocks.main: In which Gospel is the Sermon on the Mount recorded in full?
subs: In which Gospel does Jesus appear to two disciples on the road to Emmaus after His resurrection?
In which Gospel does Peter walk on water toward Jesus during a storm?
Luke
Matthew

blocks.main: In which book does Paul describe love as patient and kind in his famous "love chapter"?
subs: In which book does Paul list the fruit of the Spirit?
In which book is the teaching that faith without works is dead found?
Galatians
James

blocks.main: In which book is Paul's dramatic conversion on the road to Damascus recorded?
subs: In which book does Paul urge believers to put on the full armor of God?
In which book does Peter warn that the devil prowls around like a roaring lion?
Ephesians
1 Peter

blocks.main: In which book does John describe a new heaven, a new earth, and the holy city Jerusalem coming down?
subs: In which book is faith defined as the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen?
In which short book does Jude warn against false teachers who have secretly slipped in among believers?
Hebrews
Jude
